outcome: The app frame loads who is signed in and shows only their sections, on phone and desktop, against a contract mock
acceptance_criteria: The gate passes with the frontend present — verify: from the feature worktree, `bash <main>/delivery/checks.sh` exits 0 and its log shows "== frontend: install, lint, typecheck, test, build" with every step succeeding. `frontend/package-lock.json` is committed, and every dependency in `package.json` is an exact version.

Styles have a single source — verify: `npm test` includes a drift test that does three things. It regenerates tokens.css and psl-bundle.css in memory and asserts they equal the committed files. It asserts every `var(--x)` in psl-bundle.css is defined in tokens.css. It asserts psl-bundle.css contains no `fonts.googleapis.com` and no `.ds-` selector. `grep -rnE '#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,6}\b' frontend/src --include=*.css --include=*.tsx` matches only inside `src/styles/tokens.css` and `src/styles/psl-bundle.css`.
No runtime font call — verify: in `npm run test:e2e`, Playwright records zero requests to `fonts.googleapis.com` or `fonts.gstatic.com` when it loads `/my-work`.

The client is generated and current — verify: a vitest drift test runs openapi-typescript on openapi.json and asserts the output equals the committed `src/api/schema.d.ts`. `npm run typecheck` passes with `api.GET('/api/v1/me')` typed, and a deliberate wrong-path call in a `// @ts-expect-error` test line keeps typecheck green.
Error mapping — verify: vitest unit tests with a stubbed `fetch` cover each case below.
CSRF header — verify: unit tests check each case below.

The mock matches the contract — verify: a vitest contract test starts the mock on a random port. Every mock response must validate with Ajv 2020 against the openapi.json schema for that operation and status. The test exercises:
Navigation follows `/me` — verify: run `npm run dev`, open `http://localhost:3000/` at 1440px wide with no cookies.
Phone bar — verify: at 390×844 the desktop nav is hidden (not in the accessibility tree) and the phone bar shows Menu, PSL FACTORY and SAMPLE DATA. The menu follows the disclosure pattern:
Frame states — verify: with cookie `psl_mock_scenario` set to each value, the page shows the main content from the C5 table.
Accessibility (A-ACCESSIBILITY) — verify: `npm run test:e2e` runs `@axe-core/playwright` with tags `wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa` and reports zero violations on each of these:

Sample labelling (R-SAMPLE) — verify: SAMPLE DATA (`.psl-sample`) is visible in every frame state at both widths with default env. With `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_MODE=live npm run build && npm start` (mock still behind the rewrite), the label is absent. That is the only way to hide it.

Mock code stays out of the app — verify: after `npm run build`, `grep -rl "Tunde Bello\|mock-csrf\|psl_mock_scenario" frontend/.next/static` returns nothing. `grep -rn "from ['\"].*mock/" frontend/src` returns nothing.
No out-of-scope controls — verify: the rendered frame contains no Start work or "+ Start" control, no bell, no account menu and no sign-out. `package.json` has no `gsap` or `three`.

risk.rationale: I rated it medium rather than low: - It adds an application and a dependency tree (Next.js, a mock-server library, an OpenAPI type generator, accessibility tooling). The first frontend lint, typecheck, test and build run through `delivery/checks.sh` and must pass in the main checkout's gate. - The API client and mock encode the cross-layer contract that FE-MYWORK, FE-WORKITEM and FE-DECIDE and FE-CONNECT-1 rely on. It is not high: the shell holds no business rules, money, identity logic, migrations or concurrency, runs only locally, and the backend stays untouched. Surfaces: - `ui`: top bar, phone bar and the approved design system. - `dependency`: new npm packages and the lockfile. The surfaces exclude `auth` because the client only attaches the CSRF header defined by the contract and builds no sign-in. They exclude `contract-change` because openapi.json is consumed, not changed. Product acceptance is not required. The work conforms to the client-approved canvas 1794581312-b166 and adds no new flow, copy or business rule.
